summary: The EduPostEmployment component within the HSPnet system is a web-based user control designed for handling detailed information regarding staff post-secondary education. It facilitates data input, updates, displays, and management of education records using ASP.NET web forms, object data sources, and AJAX controls.
purpose: The purpose of the EduPostEmployment module is to manage the education records of staff post-employment, interact with data sources for retrieval and modification of data, and handle various UI operations to support data entry and display.

fields.name: GraduationConfirmed
fields.description: Flag indicating if graduation has been confirmed.

fields.name: DeliveryMethodCodeID
fields.description: Identifier for the delivery method of the education program.

actors.name: UserSession
actors.role: Maintains session-specific information for the current user.

workflows.name: Insert or Update Education Record
steps: User initiates data entry or update using the UI.
System validates input data and binds it to the corresponding data fields.
Data is submitted to the server for processing using ObjectDataSource.
Changes are committed if validation passes; otherwise, errors are shown.

business_rules: ScreenIsEditable determines whether the user interface allows data modification.
GraduationConfirmed field is represented by a dropdown, indicating a boolean state.
Redirects are used to maintain user context after data operations.
validations: Page.IsValid must be true before an insert or update is committed.
conditions: If UserSession is null, data selection is canceled to prevent unauthorized access.
system_behavior: UI controls are dynamically adjusted based on the screen mode (view, edit, insert).
JavaScript is used to initialize UI components for enhanced client-side interactions.
dependencies: HSPnetSession for managing user session data.
ASP.NET FormView and GridView controls for rendering data in tabular formats.
exceptions: Handles unauthorized access or invalid data entries through server-side validation and exception handling mechanisms.
